{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
The '''''Neverquit''''' was a small, custom built [[Starship/Legends|starship]] owed by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Grea]] the Orfite. Built on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coyn]], it was the only one of its kind, though the schematics existed to build more. The vessel looked like a [[Dagger/Legends|dagger]], with the engines set into the "handle". It had a belly-mounted [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] [[Turret/Legends|turret]]. The entire ship was black.
